title: Northbeam TechWorks Work Order Register: Jobs Held at the Same Time
content:
A customer may hold several Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair work orders at once, one for each job, and a business profile may hold many at the same time. No ceiling is set on the number a profile may carry.

## 1. The bar on a second work order for the same work

A second work order is never opened on the same item serial for the same work type while one stands asked for, booked, dispatched or held for parts. The item serial and the work type together identify the work; two jobs are the same work only when both agree.

**What is read before the work order is opened.** The bar rests on the record, not on what the customer says: the item serial, the work type and the state of every work order already standing on the profile are read from the work orders themselves before the new one is opened, and the serial read is the serial the new work order would carry.

**What still makes a second work order a different job.** Where the serial and the work type agree, two work orders are still distinguished by the day the work was asked for and by the TechWorks service they are handled under.

## 2. Annual care agreements

An annual care agreement is held alongside work orders rather than instead of them: the jobs carried out under it are their own work orders, and only one annual care agreement may run on a profile at a time.

## 3. Rework

A rework job is opened as a work order of its own against the original one and is not counted as a second job on the item.

## 4. Points of judgement

**Two televisions of the same model, two serials.** Where a household brings two identical televisions for the same repair, the serials differ, so each carries its own work order and neither blocks the other.

**A repair and an installation on one item.** Where the same item serial carries an open repair and the customer asks for an installation, the work types differ, so the second work order is not barred.

**An item already carrying a completed job.** Where the only work order on that serial and work type has been completed, called off or recorded as a failed attendance, it no longer stands in any of the four states the bar names, and a fresh work order for that work is opened in the ordinary way.
